xna-type.name: MeshContent
xna-type.summary: Provides properties and methods that define various aspects of a mesh.
xna-type.remarks: A mesh has the following characteristics: It is not jointed. For example, the wheels of a car are separate meshes from the body mesh of the same car. It may contain multiple materials. For example, the car body can be a single mesh even if the windshield component uses a different texture and shader as compared to the leather seat component of the car body. Vertices containing different channels may be mixed in a single mesh. For example, the seat geometry includes tangent vectors but the windshield does not. However, using a single mesh preserves topological continuity (shared vertex identities) across material and vertex format boundaries.
